name: GeoAgent Optimizer Lite
author: Todij AI Technology

sections.description:
Traditional SEO is evolving into GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).

GeoAgent Optimizer Lite is an essential tool designed to make your WordPress site fully compatible with modern AI bots like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini. By structuring your content and managing bot crawl signals, this plugin ensures that Large Language Models (LLMs) can easily discover, read, and cite your website as a reliable source in their generated answers.

🚀 Core Features (Lite Version)

  • Live AI Traffic Monitor: Catch and log the last 25 visits from AI bots (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) directly in your admin panel.
  • System Status Monitor: Instantly verify if your site’s GEO endpoints and AI compatibility signals are active.
  • Content Signals API: Inject ethical AI-crawling directives (ai-train=no, search=yes) via HTTP headers.
  • Markdown Engine Bypass: Deliver clean, token-efficient Markdown payloads to AI agents without breaking your site’s HTML cache.
  • Virtual XML Sitemap: Create an isolated, bot-friendly sitemap without conflicting with your existing SEO plugins.
  • “Agent-Ready” Test Engine: One-click integration with isitagentready.com to see exactly how AI models parse your domain.

🌟 Why GeoAgent?

AI Search is replacing traditional search. If your site isn’t optimized for LLM token limits and semantic extraction, you risk losing visibility in the next generation of search engines. GeoAgent bridges the gap between WordPress and the Agentic Web.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the geoagent-optimizer-lite folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the GeoAgent menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure your AI compatibility settings and monitor incoming AI traffic.
sections.faq:
Does this conflict with standard SEO plugins like Yoast or RankMath?

No. GeoAgent Optimizer operates on parallel HTTP headers and Markdown endpoints, specifically targeting AI User-Agents. It works perfectly alongside traditional SEO plugins.

Will this slow down my website?

Not at all. The plugin is extremely lightweight and uses server-side header injection and native WordPress hooks without heavy database queries.
